local function draggable(frame,handle)  
	local dragging = false  
	local dragStart  
	local startPos  
  
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)  
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y  
			)  
		end  
	end)  
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local GeneralFunctions = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GeneralFunctions)
local TeamCheck = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TeamCheck)
local Bridge = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.Bridge)
local State = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.State)
local General = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.General)

local OriginalCast = GeneralFunctions.cast
local OriginalGetHitList = GeneralFunctions.gethitlist

local Settings = {
	SilentAimEnabled = true,
	AutoFireEnabled = true,
	InfiniteAmmoEnabled = true,
	AutoFireMeleeEnabled = false,
	FieldOfView = 180,
	IgnoreTeammates = true,
	RequireVisibility = true,
	RequireMouseLocked = true,
	HeadshotRatio = 0.49,
	MaximumDistance = 1500,
	MinimumWeaponRange = 20,
	CameraOriginTolerance = 2,
	ReserveAmmo = 300,
	MaximumAmmoGuard = 999,
}

local previousAssist = getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist

if previousAssist and previousAssist.Restore then
	previousAssist.Restore()
end

local previousHook = getgenv().ArsenalRaycastHook

if previousHook and previousHook.Restore then
	previousHook.Restore()
end

local function IsAlive()
	return LocalPlayer.NRPBS.Health.Value > 0
end

local function HasWeaponEquipped()
	return State.gun ~= nil and State.equipped ~= "none"
end

local function IsMouseLocked()
	local mouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior

	return mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter or mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
end

local function IsValidTarget(player)
	if player == LocalPlayer then
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	if not character:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") then
		return false
	end

	if Settings.IgnoreTeammates and TeamCheck.isteam(LocalPlayer, character) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local function GetAimPoint(hitbox)
	local verticalOffset = hitbox.Size.Y * Settings.HeadshotRatio

	return hitbox.Position + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
end

local function GetAngleBetween(origin, direction, position)
	local offset = position - origin

	if offset.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return 0
	end

	local dotProduct = direction.Unit:Dot(offset.Unit)

	return math.acos(math.clamp(dotProduct, -1, 1))
end

local function IsVisibleFromCamera(origin, aimPoint, character, hitList)
	local offset = aimPoint - origin
	local hitInstance = OriginalCast(Ray.new(origin, offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude), hitList)

	if hitInstance == nil then
		return true
	end

	return hitInstance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function FindTarget(origin, direction, hitList)
	local maximumAngle = math.rad(Settings.FieldOfView) * 0.5
	local bestAngle = maximumAngle
	local bestHitbox = nil
	local bestAimPoint = nil

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if IsValidTarget(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local hitbox = character.Hitbox
			local aimPoint = GetAimPoint(hitbox)
			local distance = (aimPoint - origin).Magnitude

			if distance > 0.001 and distance <= Settings.MaximumDistance then
				local angle = GetAngleBetween(origin, direction, aimPoint)

				if angle < bestAngle then
					if not Settings.RequireVisibility or IsVisibleFromCamera(origin, aimPoint, character, hitList) then
						bestAngle = angle
						bestHitbox = hitbox
						bestAimPoint = aimPoint
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestHitbox, bestAimPoint
end

local function IsWeaponRay(ray)
	local originOffset = (ray.Origin - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

	return originOffset <= Settings.CameraOriginTolerance and ray.Direction.Magnitude >= Settings.MinimumWeaponRange
end

local function HookedCast(ray, hitList)
	if Settings.SilentAimEnabled and IsWeaponRay(ray) then
		local hitbox, aimPoint = FindTarget(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, hitList)

		if hitbox then
			return hitbox, aimPoint, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), hitbox.Material
		end
	end

	return OriginalCast(ray, hitList)
end

local function MaintainAmmo()
	if not Settings.InfiniteAmmoEnabled then
		return
	end

	local gun = State.gun

	if not gun then
		return
	end

	local capacity = math.min(General.getammo(gun), Settings.MaximumAmmoGuard)

	if State.equipped == "primary" then
		if State.primarymode == "2" then
			if State.primarygrenades < 1 then
				State.primarygrenades = 1
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.storedgrenades < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.storedgrenades = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		else
			if State.ammocount < capacity then
				State.ammocount = capacity
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.primarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.primarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		end
	elseif State.equipped == "secondary" then
		if State.ammo2count < capacity then
			State.ammo2count = capacity
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end

		if State.secondarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
			State.secondarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end
	end
end

local function ShouldAutoFire(hitList)
	if not Settings.AutoFireEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if not IsAlive() or not HasWeaponEquipped() then
		return false
	end

	if Settings.RequireMouseLocked and not IsMouseLocked() then
		return false
	end

	if State.equipped == "melee" and not Settings.AutoFireMeleeEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if State.reloading or State.equipping or State.taunting then
		return false
	end

	local hitbox = FindTarget(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.LookVector, hitList)

	return hitbox ~= nil
end

GeneralFunctions.cast = newcclosure(HookedCast)

local renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	MaintainAmmo()

	local hitList = OriginalGetHitList()
	local autoFire = ShouldAutoFire(hitList)
	local playerHolding = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)

	if autoFire or playerHolding then
		State.Held1 = true
	else
		State.Held1 = false
	end
end)

getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist = {
	Settings = Settings,
	FindTarget = FindTarget,
	IsWeaponRay = IsWeaponRay,
	MaintainAmmo = MaintainAmmo,
	ShouldAutoFire = ShouldAutoFire,
	OriginalCast = OriginalCast,
	Restore = function()
		GeneralFunctions.cast = OriginalCast
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
		State.Held1 = false
		getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist = nil
	end,
}

	local function UpdatePresetColor(newColor)
		PresetColor = newColor
		for _, elementData in ipairs(ColorElements) do
			if elementData.element and elementData.element.Parent then
				-- Skip toggle/dropdown elements that are in the "off" state
				if (elementData.isToggle or elementData.isDropdown) and elementData.getToggled and not elementData.getToggled() then
					continue
				end
				if elementData.type == "BackgroundColor3" then
					elementData.element.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
				elseif elementData.type == "ImageColor3" then
					elementData.element.ImageColor3 = newColor
				elseif elementData.type == "TextColor3" then
					elementData.element.TextColor3 = newColor
				end
			end
		end
	end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
env.__ChatBlocker = env.__ChatBlocker or { enabled = false, hooked = false }
local State = env.__ChatBlocker

if State.unload then
    pcall(State.unload)
end

local function isLegacyChatRemote(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance"
        and inst.ClassName == "RemoteEvent"
        and inst.Name == "SayMessageRequest"
end

local function isTextChannel(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.ClassName == "TextChannel"
end

if not State.hooked then
    State.hooked = true

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if State.enabled then
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                if method == "FireServer" and isLegacyChatRemote(self) then
                    return
                end
                if method == "SendAsync" and isTextChannel(self) then
                    return
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end))
    else
        warn("[ChatBlocker] executor has no hookmetamethod, namecall hook will not be installed")
    end

    if hookfunction then
        local function hookMethod(className, methodName, check)
            pcall(function()
                local dummy = Instance.new(className)
                local orig
                orig = hookfunction(dummy[methodName], newcclosure(function(self, ...)
                    if State.enabled and check(self) then
                        return
                    end
                    return orig(self, ...)
                end))
                dummy:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        hookMethod("RemoteEvent", "FireServer", isLegacyChatRemote)
        hookMethod("TextChannel", "SendAsync", isTextChannel)
    end
end

local function setInputBar(blocked)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
        if not cfg then
            return
        end
        if blocked then
            if State.prevBar == nil then
                State.prevBar = cfg.Enabled
            end
            cfg.Enabled = false
        elseif State.prevBar ~= nil then
            cfg.Enabled = State.prevBar

scripts.title: Undetected Noclip
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local disabled = {}
local floorY = nil
local floor = Instance.new("Part")
floor.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
floor.Anchored = true
floor.CanQuery = false
floor.CanTouch = false
floor.Transparency = 1
floor.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.RespectCanCollide = true

local function check(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not floorY then
		return
	end
	local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local halfHeight = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
	if cf.Position.Y + halfHeight > floorY + 1.5 then
		if part.CanCollide then
			disabled[part] = true
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif disabled[part] then
		disabled[part] = nil
		part.CanCollide = true
	end
end

local function scan()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "ActiveMaps", "Lobby" }) do
		local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if root then
			for _, part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				check(part)
			end
		end
	end
end

local elapsed = 3
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (root and humanoid) then
		return
	end
	local height = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(height + 30), 0), params)
	floorY = hit and hit.Position.Y or floorY or root.Position.Y - height
	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, floorY - 0.5, root.Position.Z)
	elapsed = elapsed + dt
	if elapsed >= 3 then
		elapsed = 0
		scan()
	end
end)
